name: foundation.providers

2.name: respond
2.phase: one active host provider dispatch only

1.name: call
1.envelope: EVENT; interface_handle is foundation.providers service handle; generation is module generation; sequence is shared host event sequence; correlation is invocation token

rules: No native function pointer or language object is serialized.
Defined fields use must-understand; unknown optional fields skip; unknown must-understand fields reject.
Each exact name/major/minor/schema contract is explicit. Duplicate name/major/minor conflicts. Module names cannot use foundation.*.
Provider tokens belong to the enclosing module generation and are distinct from native Registry handles.
Provider dispatch is entered only by the serialized host owner outside every Registry and guest invocation.

Exactly one accepted explicit response is provisional until the whole module dispatch and guest free return successfully. A fresh duplicate response is a terminal protocol violation; an identical gateway retry replays.
Provider RESULT_AVAILABLE and nonempty error payloads are invalid. Missing response, trap or failure after provisional response cannot become success.
Host invocation replay is separate from guest gateway replay. Retained identical host retries do not execute again; conflicting bytes fail; acknowledged and skipped old IDs expire.
Registration and response helpers acknowledge completed gateway outcomes using the application's single sequence domain.
This version executes synchronous provider functions only. Deferred guest jobs, cancellation, module-to-module calls and hot replacement are not provided.
